static func legality_point(pivot: Vector3, shape: BlockShape, basis: Basis, cube_size: float) -> Vector3
Bots must judge the same point the host does; BotStatics.OrientationInfo.center_shift already exists.

PlacementPoint.centre_offset(shape, basis, cube_size) -> Vector3 and legality_point(pivot: Vector3, shape, basis, cube_size) -> Vector3 already exist in core/rules; the hidden test calls them with BlockOrientations.get_basis(candidate.orientation_index) and checks PlacementRules.validate_point at that point.
No new names: MatchLifecycle.eliminate_slots, MatchTerritory.objective() and the objective hooks already exist at the base as typed stubs.

The tests call Match._lifecycle.eliminate_slots(slot_ids: PackedInt32Array, attackers: Dictionary = {}) and Match._territory._check_home_flags(opened: PackedInt32Array), and assign Match._territory._objective directly: keep those names and read the objective through MatchTerritory.objective() so an injected objective is honoured.

ModeObjective.resolve_eliminations(batch_teams, alive_teams, shares: PackedFloat32Array) -> int, reports_mode_results() -> bool and _declare_winner(team) already exist at the base; EliminationObjective.resolve_eliminations must latch winner() like resolve() and use its own batch, not the caller's arrays.

The seam is the mirror's existing broadcast seam: a send is broadcast(&"net_match_event", [MatchWireEvents.BLOCK_GLUED, [net_id, glued: bool]]) built via MatchEventMirror(seams: MatchIntentGateway.Seams) and bind_ports(session, host); glued_ids() returns net ids in first-glued order; on_blocks_fused/on_glue_drop_charged also apply HoneyCoat to the body, and a non-host mirror sends and tracks nothing.

HUD.reject_messages: RejectMessageTable (exported) is the table show_reject() reads; the hidden test_hud calls hud.reject_messages.message_for(reason) and expects the outside_territory sentence to contain "inside your territory" (brief example: "You can only build inside your territory."). Every PlacementRules.REASON_* except REASON_OK and ThrowRules.REASON_NOT_A_SPECIAL need an entry; no em dash and no underscore in any sentence.

run_enet_set.hold_capacity(name, processes, slots=None): within the cap it makes one call slots.godot_slots("enet:<name>", processes) and nothing else; over the cap it makes one slots.godot_exclusive(label, wait_s=EXCLUSIVE_WAIT_S). The hidden test injects a fake exposing only cap(), godot_slots(label, count, wait_s) and godot_exclusive(label, wait_s).

Existing private helpers godot_slots._take_gate(dir, pid, label, token), _gate_path(dir), busy_count(), acquire_exclusive/release_exclusive and release(index) are called by the hidden test with STACKFALL_GODOT_SLOTS=2: keep them. Behaviour: a multi-slot acquire_many holds no slot while an exclusive gate waits, and a timed-out acquire_many releases its partial set.
